name: Mono API
description: Mono is an open banking platform for Africa enabling account linking, financial data access, payments, identity verification, and data enrichment. Supports NGN (Nigeria), GHC (Ghana), KSH (Kenya), and ZAR (South Africa) currencies. Figures in API responses are in the lowest denomination (e.g. Kobo for NGN).
